text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh man… I was texting my friends for so long last night.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I swear those guys are, like, insane. They can talk literally forever and never run out of things to say.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: We talked so much. Anyway, they seem to be doing good. Yawwwn…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Tosen Jordan looks happy, she spends the whole day half asleep.
